name: Asahikawa Hime
source:
Birthplace: Hokkaido
Special skills: Singing
Hobbies: Stock trading
Favorite food: Kotobuki

Member of Kanto's project 47's "Team Rising" who is ranked the 1st between all of the project 47's idols. Hime is a genius at idol work and a genius person to boot - she gained tremendous popularity when she debuted and quickly rose to the top, is extremely talented, has tons of charisma, high ambitions and dreams as well. She is aiming to become famous worldwide and make everyone love her. She believes that if someone loves her, she is able to fully love them back no matter who they are.
